name: cgb-builder
description: Analyses TypeScript, Python, Rust, and 8 other languages to produce a queryable code graph. Provides tools for dependency analysis, impact estimation, architecture exploration, refactoring assistance, and AI context bundles.
author: cgb-builder contributors
install_instructions: Run `npm install -g cgb-builder` then `cgb init` in your project root to build the graph, then `cgb install --platform claude-code` to register this plugin.

tools.name: cgb_init
tools.description: Scan and build (or refresh) the code graph.

tools.name: cgb_deps
tools.description: Get dependencies of a file (direct + transitive).

tools.name: cgb_impact
tools.description: Find files affected if a given file changes.

tools.name: cgb_symbol
tools.description: Lookup a symbol by name or ID with callers and callees.

tools.name: cgb_callers
tools.description: Who calls a symbol (BFS over calls edges).

tools.name: cgb_callees
tools.description: What a symbol calls (BFS over calls edges).

tools.name: cgb_search
tools.description: Ranked search: exact, prefix, then full-text (BM25).

tools.name: cgb_bundle
tools.description: Generate a compact AI context bundle (Markdown).

tools.name: cgb_stats
tools.description: Graph statistics: files, nodes, edges, cycles, layers.

tools.name: cgb_path
tools.description: Shortest dependency path between two files.

tools.name: cgb_detect_changes
tools.description: Detect git changes with risk scoring and blast-radius.

tools.name: cgb_review_context
tools.description: Build a focused AI code-review context.

tools.name: cgb_large_functions
tools.description: Find large/complex functions ranked by connectivity.

tools.name: cgb_entry_points
tools.description: Discover call-chain entry points in the graph.

tools.name: cgb_call_chain
tools.description: Trace outgoing calls from a node.

tools.name: cgb_criticality
tools.description: Score nodes by criticality (fan-in, fan-out, centrality).

tools.name: cgb_communities
tools.description: Detect module clusters using Louvain algorithm.

tools.name: cgb_architecture
tools.description: Generate high-level architecture overview.

tools.name: cgb_dead_code
tools.description: Find symbols with no inbound calls or imports.

tools.name: cgb_rename_preview
tools.description: Preview renaming a symbol.

tools.name: cgb_apply_refactor
tools.description: Apply a stored rename preview to disk.

tools.name: cgb_refactor_suggest
tools.description: Suggest structural refactoring opportunities.

tools.name: cgb_wiki_generate
tools.description: Generate a Markdown wiki from graph communities.

tools.name: cgb_wiki_section
tools.description: Generate a wiki page for one community.

tools.name: cgb_registry_register
tools.description: Register a project in the global registry.

tools.name: cgb_registry_list
tools.description: List projects in the global registry.

tools.name: cgb_registry_search
tools.description: Search symbols across all registered projects.

tools.name: cgb_embed_build
tools.description: Compute and store vector embeddings for nodes.

tools.name: cgb_embed_search
tools.description: Deprecated: use cgb_search. Hybrid search (BM25 + vector).

tools.name: cgb_embed_similar
tools.description: Find nodes similar to a given node.

prompts.name: review_changes
prompts.description: Review staged changes with full impact context.

prompts.name: architecture_map
prompts.description: Summarise the project architecture using the code graph.

prompts.name: debug_issue
prompts.description: Debug an issue with code graph context loaded.

prompts.name: onboard_developer
prompts.description: Generate an onboarding guide for a new developer.

prompts.name: pre_merge_check
prompts.description: Run a pre-merge safety check across changed files.
